title: Conduit — accounts, articles, comments, favourites and discovery
context: Conduit is a public writing platform (web app + JSON API following the RealWorld specification). This story is the acceptance baseline for accounts, publishing, commenting, favouriting, following and discovering articles. All published content is public: any reader, signed in or not, must be able to discover and read any author's articles and their comments.

auth.credentials: Tests register their own qa… users through POST /api/users and use the returned token

testData.strategy: Tests create their own users through POST /api/users and their own articles through POST /api/articles (and comments/favourites/follows on them) — no pre-existing data is relied on.
constraints: accounts cannot be deleted through the API; created users are left in place (uniquely named)
testData.cleanup: Articles created by tests are deleted afterwards by their author (DELETE /api/articles/{slug}); users are left in place.
